Release a pair of rooks that travel forward, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and applying {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Immobilize'}. If the rooks hit a wall, they reflect back in the opposite direction.

Re-Activate: Split the rooks perpendicularly.
On Hit: Reduce {s:FireRateSlow}% Fire Rate for {s:DebuffDuration}s
On Hit: {s:CurrentHealthPercent}% Current Health as Damage

Promote an ally to be a knight, granting bonus stamina and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'CombatBarrier'} for a duration.

If self-cast you develop yourself as king instead, granting double the {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'CombatBarrier'} but no stamina.

Move ({g:citadel_binding:'ADS'}): Moves the piece, making it invulnerable during the duration before landing.

Can target two allies within radius.
On Self: Remove all debuffs after a move

Move ({g:citadel_binding:'ADS'}): Select a chess piece and move it to a target location, triggering effects based on the type of piece.

Move Piece has a unique cooldown per target.

Summon a queen that crashes down, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} in an area. After a delay, the queen releases squares in straight lines that deal {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} again and apply {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Stun'}.

Move ({g:citadel_binding:'ADS'}): The queen leaps to the target location, dealing the same effects again.

Re-activate to recall the queen early, ending the ability.
+{s:SlowPercent}% Slow. Checkmates heroes below {s:CheckmateThreshold} health, executing them.

Create a bishop that remains in place indefinitely.

Move ({g:citadel_binding:'ADS'}): Moves the bishop, applying a fading {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'} and dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to enemies it passes through. After a delay, activates diagonal squares that deal additional {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} when stepped on.

Re-activate to recall all bishops, ending the ability.

+{s:TileSteps} Square Range
Squares reduce Spirit Resist by {s:TechArmorDamageReductionPerStack}%, stacking {s:MaxStacks} times

In a world that moves too fast, Solomon is content to stop and listen. Offering a friendly ear and good counsel, Solomon has found himself sitting across the chess table from tourists, criminals, and titans of industry.  But no matter his opponent, Solomon remains un-phased… because to him, chess is so much more than a game.  It's an equalizer.  A way for him to connect to people from all walks of life on an even playing field.
